children: iSpecimen entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire Foldlab AI software, models, source code, data rights, IP and related assets, including disease-protein discovery and disease-trend AI tools. The $4.5 million deal includes $2.0 million in cash ($750,000 at closing and two $625,000 milestones tied to delivery and acceptance) and $2.5 million in common stock based on a 10-day VWAP. The stock consideration will be issued into a five-year escrow with a full lock-up and special voting proxy. Closing is subject to shareholder approval, Nasdaq listing confirmation, regulatory consents and other customary conditions.
